content.text: Line 63 of the relational mapper looks wrong. I'll read that file to confirm.

candidates.explanation: persistenceEntity.lastName is assigned domainEntity.firstName instead of domainEntity.lastName. Every create or update that goes through the relational mapper therefore saves the first name as the surname. This gives "Jane Jane" at registration and overwrites the surname when the profile is edited.

fix.description: Map the last name from the domain entity's lastName field.
